title: Bills
subtitle: Manage and track all your bills

header.handoff: Track open tables, partial payments, and completed bills from one revenue surface.

print.noPrinter: No bill printer registered — add one in Settings → Printers
print.queued: Bill queued for the selected print station

errors.reasonTooShort: Reason must be at least 3 characters
errors.kitchenTicketsLive: The kitchen is still working this check — bump or cancel the open tickets before voiding.

audit.title: Voids & refunds
audit.subtitle: Manager-approved actions on this bill.
audit.empty: No void or refund actions yet.

voidModal.title: Void bill #{billNumber}
voidModal.warning: Voiding cancels the bill and releases the table. This action is audited and cannot be undone.
voidModal.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this bill being voided?

refundModal.explanation: Refunds the selected payment in full. The bill total stays the same; only the payment row is reversed and the bill paid amount is decremented. External provider refunds (Stripe / on-chain) are operator-initiated and tracked separately.
refundModal.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this payment being refunded?

recordPayment.title: Payments
recordPayment.subtitlePayable: {remaining} remaining — record cash, card, or other tender.
recordPayment.subtitleReadOnly: Guest payments waiting for server or manager confirmation.
recordPayment.empty: No payments recorded yet. Use Record payment when the guest pays at the counter.

modal.title: Record payment
modal.description: Enter the amount received. Remaining balance: {remaining}.
modal.tipHint: Recorded separately from the bill balance.
modal.noteHint: For your records — not shown to the guest.

errors.amountInvalid: Enter a valid amount greater than zero.
errors.failed: Could not record payment. Try again or ask a manager.
errors.rejectFailed: Could not reject the payment request. Try again or ask a manager.
errors.cashSessionRequired: Open a cash register session before recording cash.
errors.cashSessionLookupFailed: Could not check the cash register session. Open a drawer and try again.
errors.openDrawerFailed: Could not open the cash drawer. Try the Cash Register tab.
errors.requestExpired: This payment request expired and cannot be confirmed.

warnings.cashSessionRequired: Open the cash register drawer before recording cash.

confirmation.closeBillDescription: This will permanently close the bill. Any unpaid balance will be written off. This action cannot be undone.
confirmation.closeWithoutPaymentDescription: This closes the tab but does not mark it paid. The unpaid balance will be written off. To settle cash or card, use Record payment instead.
confirmation.cancelOrderDescription: Order #{orderNumber} will be marked as cancelled. It will not be added to the bill, and it will remain visible below for staff reference.
confirmation.cancelOrderReasonPlaceholder: Optional note for staff, kitchen, or service record
confirmation.cancelOrderReasonHint: This reason will be saved in the order record and shown in the bill history.

display.title: Bill Display
display.subtitle: A live workspace for spotting attention bills and resolving them fast.
display.searchPlaceholder: Search by bill, table, counter, note, or total...
display.attentionSubtitle: Bills waiting on approval or running longer than usual.
display.openSubtitle: Active bills that are moving normally.
display.completedSubtitle: Most recently paid or closed bills.
display.emptyActive: No active open bills match this view.
display.emptyCompleted: No recent completed bills match this view.
display.ticketSummarySubtitle: Current order activity tied to this bill.
display.itemsSubtitle: Review the live bill, then edit only when needed.
display.historySubtitle: Recent changes to this bill and its orders.

editItems.title: Edit Items
editItems.currentItemsSubtitle: Review the live bill before making manual changes.
editItems.removalWarning: Removing an item here updates the live bill immediately. Use order cancellation for kitchen tickets.
editItems.itemAddFailed: Failed to add item to the bill
editItems.itemRemoveFailed: Failed to remove item from the bill
editItems.itemVoidFailed: Failed to void the item from the bill
editItems.manualChangesDescription: Manual changes update totals immediately and remain visible in bill history. Cancel orders instead when kitchen or service tickets should stay intact.
editItems.removeItemHelper: Removes this line from the live bill immediately.
editItems.voidItemDescription: {item} will be removed from the live bill, but the reason will remain in the bill timeline for staff reference.
editItems.voidReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this item is being voided
editItems.voidReasonHint: A reason is required and will be stored in the bill history.
editItems.removeItemTitle: Remove this item from the bill?
editItems.removeItemDescription: {item} will be permanently removed from the open bill and totals will be recalculated.
editItems.quantityHelper: Use quantity changes for count edits. Void requires a reason.
editItems.menuSubtitle: Search, filter, and add menu items without leaving bill context.
editItems.browseHint: Use quick add for the common path, or choose quantity and options when needed.
editItems.noCurrentItemsDescription: Add items from the menu below to keep building this bill.
editItems.autoDiscountsHint: Offers apply per order. Identical names with different amounts are separate discounts — void one if it should not apply.

inventoryWarnings.outDescription: Inventory warning: recipe requirements are not fully stocked.

emptyState.createFirstBill: Create your first bill to get started
emptyState.adjustFilters: Try adjusting your filters to see more results
emptyState.listLoadFailedHint: The list didn't load, so totals aren't shown as zero. Retry to see open checks.

warnings.activeBillsCapped: Showing the newest open bills. Narrow the date range if a check is missing.

cancelledOrdersSubtitle: Cancelled tickets stay visible so staff has a clear record.
cancelledOrdersNote: Cancelled orders are not added to the bill. They stay here briefly so the team can verify what changed.

fiscalCustomer.toggle: Need a fiscal invoice with your details?
fiscalCustomer.hint: Optional. Add your tax ID so we can issue a fiscal invoice (factura) in your name.
fiscalCustomer.cuitHint: A Factura A requires a CUIT/CUIL. Without one, we'll issue a Factura B.
fiscalCustomer.operatorHint: Optional. Capture the customer's tax ID so fiscal invoices issue correctly.
fiscalCustomer.emailHint: We'll send your fiscal invoice (factura) to this address.

cryptoRefund.title: On-chain crypto refund
cryptoRefund.subtitle: Noncustodial: you sign from the settlement wallet. Only confirmed on-chain transfers are marked refunded.
cryptoRefund.manualSupportRequired: No verified refund destination is on file for this payment. Refund requires manual support — do not invent an address.
cryptoRefund.mainnetOffNotice: Mainnet instant signing is off. Use the manual/testnet workflow and submit a transaction hash after sending USDC externally. Instant refunds are not promised.
cryptoRefund.irreversibleNotice: Submitting a transaction hash is irreversible once the chain confirms. Double-check the amount and destination.

labels.txHashHint: Paste the hash after your settlement wallet (or Safe) sends USDC.
labels.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this crypto payment being refunded?

pin.approveDescription: Approve and prepare signature / manual submission
pin.rejectDescription: Reject this refund request (ledger stays unchanged)
pin.submitDescription: Bind the on-chain transfer hash for verification

toasts.approved: Crypto refund approved — submit a transaction hash
toasts.submitted: Transaction submitted — awaiting on-chain confirmation (not refunded yet)
